# Typst skill attribution

The built-in Typst skill is adapted for Minder Agent's offline runner from
[lucifer1004/claude-skill-typst](https://github.com/lucifer1004/claude-skill-typst),
which targets Typst 0.15+. The built-in version keeps the document-authoring,
layout, table, and troubleshooting guidance relevant to this runtime and omits
upstream package-search scripts and resources that are not installed here.

The upstream skill is licensed under the MIT License; see
[claude-skill-typst-license.txt](claude-skill-typst-license.txt).
